display.purpose: The hero headline only, set across two lines at up to 6rem. Libre Caslon Display cut.

headline.purpose: Section h2s, and the address statement scaled to clamp(1.85rem, 4vw, 3.1rem) at an 18ch measure.

title.purpose: Treatment names in the ruled index, and display-face values in ruled fact rows.

lead.purpose: Hero standfirst and section intros, in soft ink.

body.purpose: All running copy, capped at 66ch (.measure), 54ch (.measure-tight) or 44ch (hero standfirst).

label.purpose: Archivo, uppercase, letterspaced. Fact labels, footer heads, masthead place. Never sets a sentence.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the build. All transitions and both entrances use it.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.value: @keyframes rise-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(1.1rem); clip-path: inset(0 0 0.6em 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0 0 -0.35em 0); } }
motion.purpose: The above-the-fold entrance. CSS-only, 1s, runs on load with no observer and no hydration dependency, so the hero is readable before React arrives. Applied to the three hero groups at 0 / 120 / 260ms.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: transition: opacity 1s var(--ease), transform 1.1s var(--ease), clip-path 1.1s var(--ease)
motion.purpose: The same gesture below the fold, triggered by IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 0px 0px -12% 0px, threshold 0.08) on the treatments head and four index rows at 70ms stagger, with a 3s failsafe that reveals anything still hidden.

motion.name: js-gate
motion.purpose: Hidden states are gated on a `.js` class set synchronously before first paint, so a browser without JS never sees a hidden page. Both motions are fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: background-color 0.4s var(--ease), color 0.4s var(--ease), border-color 0.4s var(--ease)
motion.purpose: Action hover. Colour only — nothing lifts, scales or shadows.

narrative.overview:
This is the aesthetics-clinic convention played straight and at full craft — no irony, no smuggled quirk, and none of the blush-and-rose-gold salon rendition the category defaults to. The page reads like a well-set printed sheet from a small English practice: limestone paper, one ink, hairline rules, and a single cool blue used at the strength of a printer's second colour. Restraint is not a mood here, it is the argument the copy is making, so the visual system is not allowed to twitch.

The page carries no photography, by explicit user decision — no faces, no result images, no stock skin. That is a durable constraint on this world, not a gap waiting to be filled: every future surface must be designed to be complete without images. With imagery removed, only three materials remain — type, rule weight, and space — and each therefore has to do structural work. Type is set at the scale a photograph would have occupied (the headline reaches 6rem). Rules replace every container the category would have drawn as a card. Space is generous because the craft bar the user set is Aesop, where space is the material.

Density is low and deliberate: one page, six bands, one dark band at the close carrying the phone number at its largest size anywhere. The system is flat by construction — there is not a single shadow in the build — and depth is produced entirely by ground tone and rule weight.
keyCharacteristics: Limestone ground, warm ink, one flint blue-grey as the only colour on the page
Caslon at display scale against small letterspaced Archivo labels
Hairline rules and ruled indexes; never a card, never a pill, never a badge
No photography and no icon library; three authored SVGs at 1.5 stroke on a 24 grid
Flat: zero shadows, zero gradients, zero blur
Exactly two motion moments, both optional and both reduced-motion safe

rules.name: The One Colour Rule
rules.body: Flint is the page's only colour and it appears as language, never as decoration: four italic index summaries and inline links. It may take a hover, a focus ring and a selection highlight. It may not become a fill, a badge, a bar, a chip, or a heading colour.

rules.name: The Two Rule Weights Rule
rules.body: Rules are the only structural material on a page with no images, so the two weights carry hierarchy and must not be interchanged. --stone-line divides sections and both opens and closes a list; --stone-line-soft divides rows within one list. A third rule weight is not available.

rules.name: The Browser Surfaces Rule
rules.body: The parts nobody draws still belong to the design. ::selection, caret-color, accent-color, the custom scrollbar, and focus-visible rings are all themed from this palette, and the ring inverts to --night-fg inside the dark band. A new surface inherits these; it does not restyle them.

rules.name: The Archivo Never Sets a Sentence Rule
rules.body: Archivo sets letterspaced uppercase labels, button text and footer column heads. It never sets a sentence, a paragraph, or a heading. The footer address and the safety statement are set in the text face for exactly this reason.

rules.name: The Two Caslons Rule
rules.body: Display cut for display sizes, Text cut for everything read as prose — including the italic index summaries. Never press the Display cut into body copy.

rules.name: The Figure Carries Its Denominator Rule
rules.body: A rating figure never appears without its count in the same breath, one type step apart ("5.0" / "from one review on Google"). A large number with the count hidden is the badge this page exists to refuse.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No kicker, eyebrow or label sits above any heading anywhere on this page. The heading carries its own weight; a label above it is furniture. Where a section might have wanted one — the visit section — the address is promoted to the heading instead.

rules.name: The Band, Not the Box Rule
rules.body: Structure is expressed as full-bleed horizontal bands (ground, tint, night) separated by hairlines. Never as a boxed container floating on a background.

rules.name: The Composition Was Never Comped Rule
rules.body: No comp was produced; composition was approved only at finish review. Nothing in this layout — the 5fr/7fr split, the two-line headline, the address-as-heading, the section order — rests on a client-approved design. A later change to the composition must be argued on its own merits and re-reviewed; it must not lean on an approval that does not exist.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing on this page casts a shadow, and nothing ever will. If a new element needs to separate from its surroundings, it changes ground tone or gains a hairline. It does not gain elevation.

rules.name: The Square Action Rule
rules.body: Actions are rectangles. No pills, no capsules, no rounded cards. If a control needs to feel softer, it gets more padding, not more radius.

rules.name: The Content Ships Visible Rule
rules.body: Animation may only ever remove itself. Hidden-by-default states are gated on JS being present and carry a time-based failsafe; a broken observer, a slow bundle or a disabled script must leave the page fully readable, never blank.

rules.name: The One Gesture Rule
rules.body: There is one authored motion — rise and un-clip — and it is used twice. A new surface reuses it or moves not at all. A page whose whole argument is restraint cannot twitch.

dos: Do design every new surface to be complete without images. The no-photography decision is a standing constraint on this world, not a temporary gap.
Do carry structure on the two rule weights: --stone-line between sections and to close a list, --stone-line-soft between rows inside one list.
Do keep flint as language — italic index summaries and inline links, plus hover, focus and selection states. Nothing else.
Do set running copy in Libre Caslon Text at a 44–66ch measure, and secondary copy in --ink-soft (never a neutral grey).
Do use the square action, ink-solid for the one primary call and ghost for the secondary, with colour-only transitions on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do publish a rating figure only alongside its count, one type step apart.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces — selection, caret, accent, scrollbar, focus ring — from this palette, inverting the ring to --night-fg inside the dark band.
Do re-review any composition change at finish review. No comp was produced; composition was approved only at finish review.
donts: Don't add photography, illustration, or generated imagery of any kind.
Don't introduce a card, a tile, a panel, or any boxed container. Ruled lists and ruled bands only.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow or label above a heading. If a section seems to need one, the heading is underweight — fix the heading.
Don't add a shadow, gradient, blur or backdrop filter. The page is flat paper.
Don't round a corner. Actions are rectangles; pills belong to the category this build refuses.
Don't set a sentence in Archivo, or body copy in Libre Caslon Display.
Don't add a star row, a rating badge, or any icon library — three authored SVGs at 1.5 stroke on a 24 grid are the whole icon set, and there is deliberately no star.
Don't use --ink-faint for running text; it is a decorative tone only.
Don't add a second colour, a second accent, or a third rule weight.
Don't add a new animation. Reuse the one gesture, or stay still.
